chunks: And in the narration of Samāʿah, he said:

I asked him about a man who divorced his wife, then died before her waiting period had ended. He said: She must observe the waiting period of a woman whose husband has died, and she has the inheritance.

key_terms.الْمُتَوَفَّى: the woman whose husband has died
key_terms.الْمِيرَاثُ: the inheritance due from the deceased
key_terms.تَعْتَدُّ: she observes the legally required waiting period

ai.seo_question: If a man divorces his wife and then dies before her waiting period ends, does she inherit and what 'iddah must she observe?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a woman whose husband dies after divorcing her but before the completion of her waiting period. It states that she must observe the 'iddah of widowhood and that she retains the right to inherit from him.
